entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.4049 Of 2023
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners/Accused Nos.4 and 5 to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.17 of 2023 of Station House Officer, Nizamabad V Town Police Station, Nizamabad.

entities.text: Nizamabad V Town Police Station, Nizamabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 406, 420, 448, 290, 323 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC").
2. Heard both sides.

3. After arguing sometime, learned counsel for the petitioners confines his prayer to direct the police to follow the procedure prescribed under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. for reason of the offences alleged against the petitioners are punishable less than seven (07) years.

4. In view of the aforesaid submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners, this Criminal Petition is disposed of directing the Investigating Officer in Crime No.17 of 2023 of Station House Officer, Nizamabad V Town Police Station, Nizamabad, to strictly follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1.

entities.text: Nizamabad V Town Police Station, Nizamabad
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners shall co- operate with the Investigating Officer by furnishing information and documents as sought by them in concluding the investigation.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
